raw.details:
INCURSION 2027 | 24-Hour National Level Hackathon in India

INCURSION 2027 is a FREE-TO-REGISTER National Level Hackathon organized by Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri, Pune.

Bring your ideas to life, collaborate with innovators from across India and build technology-driven solutions to real-world challenges.

INCURSION 2027 is a 24-hour national-level student hackathon featuring multiple online selection rounds and an offline Grand Finale on 30–31 January 2027 at Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri, Pune.

Open to students from all academic domains, engineering branches and technical specializations, the hackathon encourages interdisciplinary collaboration across Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Development, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, Electronics, Robotics, IoT and other emerging technologies.

With a prize pool worth ₹2,00,000, INCURSION 2027 provides a platform to demonstrate technical expertise, creativity, innovation and practical problem-solving skills.

EVENT HIGHLIGHTS

  • Event: INCURSION 2027

  • Type: National Level 24-Hour Hackathon

  • Organizer: Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pune

  • Registration: FREE for preliminary rounds

  • Team Size: 2–4 Members

  • Eligibility: Undergraduate and postgraduate students across academic domains

  • Cross-Domain Participation: Allowed

  • Competition Mode: Online Selection Rounds + Offline Grand Finale

  • Finalists: Top 50 Teams

  • Finalist Confirmation Fee: ₹899 per team

  • Prize Pool: ₹2,00,000

  • Grand Finale: 30–31 January 2027

  • Venue: DIT Pimpri, Pune, Maharashtra, India

IMPORTANT: FREE REGISTRATION & PARTICIPATION

Registration and participation in all preliminary online rounds are completely FREE!

There is absolutely no registration or participation fee for Round 0, Round 1, Round 2, Round 3 or Round 4.

Competition Stage Participation Fee
Round 0: Registration & Team Formation FREE
Round 1: PPT Submission FREE
Round 2: Online PPT Evaluation FREE
Round 3: Working Prototype Submission FREE
Round 4: Online Prototype Evaluation FREE
Round 5: Offline Grand Finale ₹899 per shortlisted team

ONLY THE TOP 50 SHORTLISTED TEAMS WILL BE REQUIRED TO PAY ₹899 PER TEAM to confirm their participation in the offline Grand Finale.

  • No payment is required during initial registration.

  • No payment is required for preliminary online rounds.

  • The ₹899 fee is charged per team, not per participant.

  • Payment instructions will be shared directly with shortlisted team leaders.

  • Final participation is subject to successful confirmation and verification.

Register for FREE. Compete through the online rounds. Earn your place among the Top 50 finalists!

ABOUT INCURSION 2027

INCURSION 2027 is a national-level 24-hour hackathon designed to bring together students, developers, programmers, engineers, designers, researchers and innovators from diverse academic backgrounds.

The competition focuses on identifying real-world problems and developing practical, scalable and innovative solutions using technology.

Through a structured multi-round competition, participating teams will progress from idea presentations to technical evaluations and working prototype demonstrations.

The hackathon encourages domain-specific and interdisciplinary approaches, allowing participants to combine different areas of knowledge and develop impactful solutions.

The Top 50 shortlisted teams will qualify for the offline Grand Finale at DIT Pimpri, Pune.

ELIGIBILITY & CROSS-DOMAIN PARTICIPATION

INCURSION 2027 welcomes students from ALL academic disciplines, educational backgrounds and technical specializations.

The hackathon is not restricted to Computer Science or Information Technology students.

Eligible academic domains include:

1. Computer Science & Computing

  • Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)

  • Information Technology (IT)

  • Computer Engineering

  • Software Engineering

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

  • Artificial Intelligence and Data Science

  • Data Science and Big Data Analytics

  • Cybersecurity and Information Security

  • Cloud Computing

  • Computer Networks

2. Core Engineering & Technology

  • Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)

  • Electrical Engineering

  • Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE)

  • Mechanical Engineering

  • Civil Engineering

  • Instrumentation Engineering

  • Robotics and Automation

  • Mechatronics Engineering

  • Internet of Things (IoT)

  • Other engineering and technology specializations

3. Management & Business

  • Business Administration

  • Management Studies

  • Finance

  • Marketing

  • Entrepreneurship

  • Business Analytics

4. Other Academic Domains

  • Science and Mathematics

  • Physics and Chemistry

  • Life Sciences

  • Commerce and Economics

  • Arts and Humanities

  • Design and User Experience

  • Law

  • Medical and Allied Disciplines

  • Other undergraduate and postgraduate disciplines

CROSS-DOMAIN AND INTERDISCIPLINARY TEAMS ARE ALLOWED!

Students from different academic branches, departments, colleges, universities and specializations can collaborate in one team, subject to the team-size requirements.

Examples of interdisciplinary teams:

  • Computer Science + Electronics

  • AI & Data Science + Mechanical Engineering

  • Cybersecurity + Management

  • Civil Engineering + IoT

  • Design + Software Development

  • Medical or Life Sciences + Artificial Intelligence

Your academic branch does not limit your opportunity to participate. Your ideas, innovation, implementation and problem-solving approach matter.

TEAM FORMATION GUIDELINES

  • Minimum Team Size: 2 Members

  • Maximum Team Size: 4 Members

  • Cross-domain teams are allowed.

  • Inter-college and interdisciplinary collaboration is welcome.

  • Each team must designate one Team Leader.

  • Every participant must complete the required Unstop registration.

  • Each participant can belong to only one registered team.

  • Teams must provide accurate participant and institutional information.

HACKATHON TRACKS & TECHNOLOGY AREAS

INCURSION 2027 features five dedicated tracks covering emerging technologies, real-world challenges and open innovation.

1. ROGUE PROTOCOL: AI & AGENTIC AI

Explore the possibilities of Artificial Intelligence and autonomous systems.

Suggested areas:

  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

  • Generative AI

  • Agentic AI and AI Agents

  • Natural Language Processing

  • Computer Vision

  • Intelligent Automation

  • AI-powered applications

2. FIREWALL ZERO: CYBERSECURITY & FINTECH

Develop secure, intelligent and innovative solutions for digital security and financial technology.

Suggested areas:

  • Cybersecurity

  • Information Security

  • Threat Detection

  • Fraud Detection

  • Financial Technology

  • Secure Digital Transactions

  • Privacy and Data Protection

3. FINAL HOUR: OPEN INNOVATION

Build innovative solutions addressing real-world problems across any suitable technology domain.

Suggested areas:

  • Software Development

  • Web and Mobile Applications

  • Cloud Computing

  • Data Science

  • Automation

  • Emerging Technologies

  • Interdisciplinary Innovation

4. GLASS WALL: GOVTECH

Use technology to improve governance, public services and civic infrastructure.

Suggested areas:

  • Digital Governance

  • Public Service Technology

  • Civic Innovation

  • E-Governance

  • Government Process Automation

  • Digital Infrastructure

  • Public Welfare Solutions

5. SURVIVAL CITY: SMART CITIES

Develop intelligent solutions for sustainable, connected and efficient urban environments.

Suggested areas:

  • Internet of Things

  • Smart Infrastructure

  • Robotics and Automation

  • Sustainable Technology

  • Urban Mobility

  • Environmental Monitoring

  • Connected Systems

Participants should select the track that best matches their proposed solution.

COMPETITION STRUCTURE & SELECTION PROCESS

INCURSION 2027 follows a six-stage competition structure. All preliminary selection rounds are conducted online.

ROUND 0: REGISTRATION & TEAM FORMATION

PARTICIPATION FEE: FREE

Register through the official Unstop opportunity page, form a team of 2–4 members and complete the required participant details.

Registration Period: 11 November – 5 December 2026.

Registration Guidelines:

  • Register through Unstop.

  • Add all team members to the same team.

  • Designate one Team Leader.

  • Complete all mandatory profile details.

  • Finalize team formation before the deadline.

ROUND 1: PPT SUBMISSION

PARTICIPATION FEE: FREE

Registered teams must submit a PowerPoint presentation outlining their proposed solution to a real-world problem.

Expected PPT contents:

  • Problem statement and understanding

  • Proposed solution and key features

  • Proposed system architecture

  • Technology stack

  • Implementation approach

  • Potential impact and feasibility

Submission Guidelines:

  • Submit your presentation in PPT or PDF format.

  • Ensure the presentation is clear and well-structured.

  • Only one submission per team is required.

  • Submit before the deadline.

Submission Period: 6–12 December 2026.

ONLINE PPT EVALUATION & EXPERT REVIEW

PARTICIPATION FEE: FREE

All submitted presentations will be evaluated online by a panel of industry professionals and faculty members.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Problem understanding and clarity

  • Innovation and originality

  • Technical approach and architecture

  • Feasibility and execution plan

  • Real-world impact and scalability

Promising teams will be shortlisted for the Working Prototype Submission Round.

Evaluation Period: 13–19 December 2026.

ROUND 2: WORKING PROTOTYPE SUBMISSION

PARTICIPATION FEE: FREE

Shortlisted teams must demonstrate their proposed solutions through a working prototype.

Required Submissions:

  1. Demo Video: A 3–5 minute video showcasing the working prototype and key functionalities.

  2. GitHub Repository: An accessible repository containing the source code and README documentation with setup instructions.

  3. Project Details: Project description, technologies used and implemented features.

  4. Live Demo: Deployment link, if available.

Guidelines:

  • Ensure all submission links are accessible.

  • Demonstrate the actual working implementation.

  • Provide complete and accurate information.

  • Submit all materials before the deadline.

Submission Deadline: 25 December 2026, 10:00 PM IST.

ONLINE PROTOTYPE EVALUATION & TECHNICAL ASSESSMENT

PARTICIPATION FEE: FREE

Submitted prototypes and GitHub repositories will undergo an in-depth technical assessment by the evaluation panel.

Evaluation Criteria:

  • Working prototype and functionality

  • Technical implementation and code quality

  • Innovation and originality

  • System architecture and scalability

  • Feasibility and problem relevance

Based on the evaluation, the Top 50 performing teams will be shortlisted for the INCURSION 2027 Grand Finale.

Evaluation Period: 25 December 2026 – 5 January 2027.

Top 50 Finalist Announcement: 6 January 2027.

ROUND 3: GRAND FINALE – 24-HOUR NATIONAL HACKATHON

FINALIST CONFIRMATION FEE: ₹899 PER TEAM

The Top 50 shortlisted teams will compete in the offline 24-hour Grand Finale at Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri, Pune.

  • Mode: Offline

  • Duration: 24 Hours

  • Dates: 30–31 January 2027

  • Venue: Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri, Pune

Selected teams will collaborate, develop their solutions and demonstrate their technical capabilities through an intensive hackathon experience.

Participation is restricted to officially selected finalist teams that complete the confirmation process.

FINALIST CONFIRMATION FEE

The ₹899 finalist confirmation fee applies exclusively to the Top 50 shortlisted teams.

  • ₹899 per team, not per participant.

  • No payment during initial registration.

  • No payment for Rounds 0–4.

  • Payment instructions will be shared with shortlisted Team Leaders.

  • Final participation is subject to payment and verification within the communicated deadline.

IMPORTANT DATES & TIMELINE

All dates and times are in Indian Standard Time (IST).

Competition Milestone Start Date & Time (IST) End Date & Time (IST)
Round 0: Registration & Team Formation 11 November 2026, 10:00 PM 5 December 2026, 10:00 PM
Round 1: PPT Submission 6 December 2026, 10:00 PM 12 December 2026, 10:00 PM
Round 2: Online PPT Evaluation 13 December 2026, 10:00 PM 19 December 2026, 10:00 PM
Round 3: Working Prototype Submission 20 December 2026, 10:00 PM 25 December 2026, 10:00 PM
Round 4: Online Prototype Evaluation 25 December 2026, 10:00 PM 5 January 2027, 10:00 PM
Top 50 Finalist Announcement 6 January 2027 6 January 2027
Round 5: Grand Finale 30 January 2027, 9:00 AM 31 January 2027, 9:00 AM

All preliminary rounds are free. Only the Top 50 shortlisted teams pay ₹899 per team to confirm their offline Grand Finale participation.

PRIZES & REWARDS

TOTAL PRIZE POOL: ₹2,00,000

INCURSION 2027 recognizes outstanding innovation, technical implementation, creativity and real-world impact.

OVERALL WINNER: ₹1,00,000

Awarded to the team demonstrating the best overall solution, execution, impact and demonstration.

1ST RUNNER-UP: ₹50,000

Awarded to the second-best overall project.

2ND RUNNER-UP: ₹25,000

Awarded to the third-best overall project.

TRACK-WISE AWARDS

  • Best Rogue Protocol: ₹5,000 – AI & Agentic Systems track excellence.

  • Best Firewall Zero: ₹5,000 – Cybersecurity & FinTech track excellence.

  • Best Glass Wall: ₹5,000 – GovTech track excellence.

  • Best Survival City: ₹5,000 – Smart Cities track excellence.

  • Best Final Hour: ₹5,000 – Open Innovation, with additional emphasis on solving important real-world problems.

ADDITIONAL RECOGNITION

  • Participation Certificate

  • Recognition for outstanding projects

  • Opportunity to showcase solutions at a national-level hackathon

All prizes and certificates will be released within 30 days after the event is over.

GRAND FINALE VENUE

Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri, Pune.

Address: Sant Tukaram Nagar, Pimpri, Pune – 411018, Maharashtra, India.

Dates: 30–31 January 2027
Duration: 24 Hours
Mode: Offline
Finalists: Top 50 Teams

RULES & GUIDELINES

  1. Each team must consist of 2–4 registered members.

  2. Students from different academic domains, branches and institutions may form a team, subject to official registration requirements.

  3. Every participant must complete the required registration process.

  4. Teams must follow official submission instructions and deadlines.

  5. PPT submissions must explain the problem, proposed solution and technical approach.

  6. Prototype submissions must include a demonstration video and accessible GitHub repository.

  7. Teams must provide accurate participant and institutional information.

  8. Only officially shortlisted teams qualify for the Grand Finale.

  9. The ₹899 finalist confirmation fee applies only to the Top 50 shortlisted teams.

  10. Finalists must attend the offline Grand Finale at DIT Pimpri, Pune.

  11. All participants must follow the organizing committee's official instructions and code of conduct.

OFFICIAL WEBSITE & COMMUNITY

Official Website: https://incursion.tech

Discord Community:
https://discord.com/invite/QYQZBEmgQ

WhatsApp Community:
https://chat.whatsapp.com/Ft9BS6SI4ar5cyiev5muGh

Join the official communities to receive:

  • Hackathon announcements

  • Round-wise submission reminders

  • Important deadlines and updates

  • Clarifications and participant support

  • Finalist and Grand Finale information

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

1. Is INCURSION 2027 free to register?

Yes. Registration and participation in all preliminary online rounds are completely free.

2. Can students from non-Computer Science branches participate?

Yes. Students from all eligible academic domains and engineering branches are welcome.

3. Are cross-domain teams allowed?

Yes. Students from different branches, departments and academic specializations can form a team.

4. Can students from different colleges participate together?

Teams may include students from different institutions, subject to the official registration and eligibility requirements.

5. What is the team size?

Each team must have a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 4 members.

6. Is ₹899 required during registration?

No. Under the stated fee policy, only the Top 50 shortlisted teams pay ₹899 per team to confirm their offline Grand Finale participation.

7. Is the hackathon online or offline?

The preliminary selection rounds are online. The Grand Finale is offline at DIT Pimpri, Pune.

8. How many teams will qualify for the Grand Finale?

The Top 50 performing teams will be shortlisted.

9. When will the finalists be announced?

6 January 2027.

10. When and where is the Grand Finale?

30–31 January 2027 at Dr. D. Y. Patil Institute of Technology, Pimpri, Pune.

11. What is the total prize pool?

The total advertised prize pool is ₹2,00,000.

12. Will participants receive certificates?

Participation certificates are included as part of the event recognition.

REGISTER FOR INCURSION 2027

Whether you are a Computer Science student, an AI enthusiast, a core engineering student, a designer, a researcher, a management student or an innovator from another academic domain, INCURSION 2027 welcomes your ideas.

Build across domains. Collaborate across disciplines. Solve real-world problems. Compete at the national level.

Register for FREE and earn your place among the Top 50 finalist teams!

Official Unstop Registration:
https://unstop.com/hackathons/incursion-2027-24-hour-national-level-hackathon-dr-dy-patil-institute-of-technology-1806016

Official Website:
https://incursion.tech

INCURSION 2027 – TIME RUNS OUT.
